text: A股三大指数今日集体上涨，截至收盘，上证指数涨1.08%，深证成指涨1.63%，创业板指涨1.87%，北证50涨0.58%，科创50指数涨3.11%。全市场成交额17952亿元，较上日放量1075亿元，全市场超4600只个股上涨。板块题材上，影视院线、游戏、文化传媒、AI视频、软件开发板块涨幅居前；贵金属、银行、煤炭开采加工、油气开采及服务板块下跌。盘面上，影视院线板块今日集体爆发，华智数媒、捷成股份、博纳影业、中视传媒、上海电影等多股涨停，华策影视、百纳千成、幸福蓝海涨幅居前。游戏板块持续走高，电魂网络、巨人网络、大晟文化等股涨停，富春股份、冰川网络、
text_en: The three major A-share indices rose collectively today. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.08%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%, the BSE 50 rose 0.58%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 3.11%. Market-wide turnover was 1,795.2 billion yuan, up 107.5 billion yuan from the previous day, with more than 4,600 stocks across the market advancing. By sector, film and cinema chains, gaming, cultural media, AI video and software development ranked among the top gainers; precious metals, banking, coal mining and processing, and oil and gas extraction and services declined. On the board, the film and cinema chain sector surged collectively today, with multiple stocks including Huazhi Digital Media, Jiecheng Shares, Bona Film Group, China Television Media and Shanghai Film hitting the daily limit, while Huace Film & TV, Bainaqiancheng and Xingfu Lanhai ranked among the top gainers.
